scenes: How do you keep working when it’s too hot to work?
You build rest into every hour. | In Singapore, heavy outdoor work at a WBGT of thirty-two or more needs at least ten minutes of shaded rest an hour.
Rules work when they’re checked. | In 2024, inspectors visited two hundred and fifty sites, and acted against seventy-eight.
Rest protects when it’s shaded, built in, and actually taken.
